meta.curriculum_authority: المركز الوطني لتطوير المناهج والتقويم (NCCD) - وزارة التربية والتعليم الأردنية
source_books: كتاب الطالب لمادة اللغة الإنجليزية للصف الخامس الفصل الأول (g5-english-s1-pupils-book, Jordan Team Together series, Pearson/York Press)
meta.provenance_note: Read directly from the PDF via PyMuPDF on 2026-09-16 — extraction is clean (this book is in English, so none of the Arabic-extraction issues that hit other Grade 5 books apply). Unit titles, page numbers, vocabulary, grammar structures (with the book's own example sentences), and skill descriptors were taken from the book's own two-page 'Scope and sequence' table (pp. 4-5), which is unambiguous and easy to verify against the Contents page. Individual page-by-page lesson numbering inside each unit ('Lesson 1', 'Lesson 2'...) follows an inconsistent odd/even pattern across units in the raw extraction and was not reliably reconstructable without much deeper page-by-page reading, so each unit here is split into exactly two lessons — Vocabulary & Grammar, and Listening & Speaking — reflecting the two content halves the scope-and-sequence table itself separates, not the book's own internal lesson count.
known_gaps: This is real content (vocabulary lists, grammar points with the book's own example sentences, skill descriptors), not title-only — but it is unit-level, not lesson-level: each unit's actual internal lesson count and exact per-lesson titles (as printed inside the unit, e.g. 'Lesson 1: Vocabulary') were not verified page by page.

Following the g7EngSem1.ts precedent for English-subject books, `main_idea_ar` and `objectives` hold literal English text (this book's own language), not Arabic; `title_ar` carries a plain Arabic gloss of the English title for search/display.

'Welcome back' (the review unit opening the book) is included as Unit 1 here because it carries its own new vocabulary and grammar point in the scope-and-sequence table, not just a recap of Grade 4 — same treatment as every other unit.

Excluded as supplementary, non-core material (no dedicated row in the scope-and-sequence table): the two 'Bo's Learning Club: Language booster' spreads, the 'Festivals' pages (Harvest Festival, World Water Day), 'Solve it', and the 'Grammar reference' appendix.
